ai_summary.key_headline: Tuchel's Reshaped England Meets Modric's Farewell-Tour Croatia

england.philosophy: Tuchel's structured possession with positional fullbacks and direct wide threats.

croatia.philosophy: Veteran midfield tempo control built around Modric and Kovacic possession cycles.

tactical_insights: England's Declan Rice and Elliot Anderson will look to press Modric and Kovacic early to disrupt Croatia's passing rhythm.
Croatia's ageing midfield core will try to slow the tempo against the legs of England's Bellingham and Eze.
Jude Bellingham's direct runs from deep will challenge Croatia's central defensive block in Modric's last World Cup.
